caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless double-breasted vest with a high collar, shown from both the front and the back. The front view is rendered in color, displaying a light beige or cream-colored fabric with horizontal lines, decorated with floral or butterfly-like embroidered motifs in a darker, grayish tone. The vest features six round buttons in two vertical rows and has the motifs distributed across the front panels, collar, and near the hem. There is additional decorative embroidery along the bottom edge. The back view is rendered in simple line work, lacking color and embroidery detail, indicating the structural lines and a small tie at the back waist. The drawing is set against an off-white background with slight yellowing toward the edges.
title: Waistcoat
